sources.title: Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF is a 9-billion parameter dense language model built for code generation and agentic reasoning, maintained by ornith-ai. This is a quantized GGUF variant of the full-precision model, enabling deployment on consumer hardware while maintaining the reasoning capabilities of the original. sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 9B is the model from DeepReinforce's new Ornith 1.5 family that you can actually run locally: a dense 9B multimodal coding model that fits on an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization. This guide covers our Atomic Dynamic GGUF builds, how much memory each one needs, and the exact setup for both Atomic Chat and llama.cpp.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.
